content.short: Holoframe builds XR software for NFT collectors and projects to showcase NFTs in dynamic 3D frames and AR.
content.description: Holoframe solves the problem of static NFTs by enabling users to showcase them in dynamic 3D frames. Users can view and record their NFTs in AR, customize frames with colors and materials, and share them on social media or embed them on websites. The platform and API enable creators and Web3 companies to frame their entire NFT collections.
content.meta: Holoframe enables showcasing NFTs in dynamic 3D frames and AR. Discover Holoframe and other Web3 Gaming Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
